svg.text: OpenRouter's traffic does not predict OpenCode's
The same matched models by share of tokens. Axes are log scales; the diagonal is equal share. Above it, a model is bigger on OpenRouter than on OpenCode.
Scatter: OpenRouter's latest 28 complete days (2026-10-11 to 2026-11-07) against OpenCode's latest 28 complete days (2026-10-06 to 2026-11-02).
Spearman rank correlation +0.02 across 8 matched models. The rolling panel asks whether that agreement is stable.
Does the agreement persist? Rolling 28-day rank correlation
Model line: eight hand-matched models, equal weight. Lab line: common labs, equal weight. Both are rank correlations.
Router traffic and client traffic do not move together. The latest rank correlation is +0.02; the model-level rolling median is +0.12 and the sign changes.
Rank-weighted on purpose: each matched model counts once. Token-weighting would be dominated by DeepSeek, which is the thing being tested.
Dollar weights are unavailable because OpenCode publishes session cost, not per-model revenue. The lab line is a coarser cross-check, not a law.
Matched by hand across OpenCode slugs and OpenRouter permaslugs; 8 models. Free and paid variants of the same base model are aggregated.
Sources: OpenRouter rankings, as of 2026-11-08T10:34:47.917Z; OpenCode Data (opencode.ai/data).
